title: LoRASpace: A Pool-Wide Shared Substrate for Static and Dynamic Multi-LoRA Composition
abstract: arXiv:2610.27444v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) attaches small low-rank matrices to a frozen backbone, and public repositories host many LoRAs per backbone, each for a different concept or task. Combining several LoRAs in one generation forces a trade-off. Merging their weights into one update needs a single forward pass, but LoRAs trained for different concepts interfere and quality drops. Running each LoRA in its own forward pass (composite) preserves quality, but inference time grows linearly with the number of active LoRAs. We study a property of LoRA pools overlooked by prior multi-LoRA work. In real LoRA pools, the stacked low-rank factors need far fewer directions than their summed ranks. Using singular value decomposition, we find the minimal subspace that keeps 99% of the factor energy. On three diffusion pools, only 46% to 57% of the summed LoRA ranks is needed, and the subspace grows sub-linearly with pool size. A 48-LoRA sub-pool of LoRA-Hub on

translated_title: LoRASpace：一种面向静态与动态多LoRA组合的池级共享基底
translated_abstract: 低秩适配在冻结的主干模型上附加小型低秩矩阵，而公共仓库中每个主干模型托管着众多LoRA，各自对应不同的概念或任务。在一次生成中组合多个LoRA迫使人们做出权衡：将它们的权重合并为一次更新只需单次前向传播，但为不同概念训练的LoRA会相互干扰，导致质量下降；而让每个LoRA在各自的前向传播中运行（组合式）虽能保持质量，但推理时间会随激活LoRA数量的增加而线性增长。我们研究了以往多LoRA工作所忽视的LoRA池的一个特性：在真实的LoRA池中，堆叠的低秩因子所需的方向数远少于其秩的总和。利用奇异值分解，我们找到了保留99%因子能量的最小子空间。在三个扩散模型池上，仅需LoRA秩总和的46%至57%，且该子空间随池规模呈次线性增长。LoRA-Hub上包含48个LoRA的子池……
tldr: 该论文发现真实LoRA池中的低秩因子仅需其秩总和的46%-57%即可保留99%的能量，并据此提出池级共享基底LoRASpace，使多LoRA组合同时获得权重合并的速度与逐LoRA前向传播的质量。
en_tdlr: The paper discovers that low-rank factors in real LoRA pools retain 99% of their energy in a subspace of only 46%-57% of the summed ranks, and proposes LoRASpace, a pool-wide shared substrate enabling multi-LoRA composition that combines the speed of weight merging with the quality of per-LoRA forward passes.
